remaining.issue: Six-item reading/followed preview has no route to every remaining candidate.
remaining.needs: API: returning reader can continue the ranked reading and followed Works beyond six.

remaining.issue: FollowedAuthorsSection ignores nextCursor, including empty filtered pages.
readOverview discards the bounded directory remainder; shelves beyond five pages also become missing on direct navigation.
scan stops after five pages and returns successful partial arrays without continuation; late failures also become success.
remaining.needs: API: writer can list their texts/submissions for one Work without scanning their population.

remaining.issue: Concept choices return only a twelve-item first page and discard its continuation.
questions drains an unbounded population in a do/while cursor loop.
readLabels ignores LABEL_PAGES whenever needed is supplied, scanning without a page bound until all requested labels are found or the population ends.
readWorkContinuities returns capped options without continuation and treats late failures as successful partial choices.
readRatings exposes the first context page as all available choices, dropping nextCursor.
Without a live loader, an incomplete initial page is rewritten to nextCursor=null and complete=true.
relationPages caps traversal and its series-progress-panel consumer has no control to resume the remaining relations; late failures become successful partial data.
